evals.prompt: readwise-daily-pulse 실행. PULSE_PROFILE, PULSE_INTERESTS, PULSE_TO는 환경 변수 값을 사용.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the variables from the environment without echoing them, computes the local-day window, paginates new/later/feed plus highlights with the client-side saved_at filter, writes the digest in the fixed section order with continuous numbering, passes check_draft.py, and creates a plain-text Gmail draft to PULSE_TO.

evals.prompt: 어제 Readwise에 저장한 글 정리해서 메일 초안으로 만들어줘. 프로필은 백엔드 엔지니어, 관심 주제는 데이터베이스, 메시지 큐, 관측성.
evals.expected_output: Uses the profile and interests given in the call text, excludes unrelated documents from the top sections regardless of quality, puts confirmed product changes under ## changelog with one type suffix each, and reports counts plus which variables fell back to defaults.

evals.prompt: 리더 데일리 펄스 돌려줘. Readwise MCP는 없고 READWISE_TOKEN만 환경 변수에 있어.
evals.expected_output: Falls back to PULSE_SOURCE=cli, runs collect_readwise.py with --with-content, never prints the token, and when there are no documents in the window creates a draft whose body is only '어제 들어온 항목 없음'.
